nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner (Owned.owner).
Pending new owner address set during two-step ownership transfer.
ERC20 token symbol 'IST34'.
ERC20 token name 'IST34 Token'.
Token decimals, set to 18.
Internal total supply (1e12 * 10**18).
Mapping of account balances.
Nested mapping of allowances owner => spender => amount.
Library addition with overflow check c = a + b; require(c >= a).
Library subtraction with underflow check require(b <= a); c = a - b.
Library multiplication with overflow check c = a * b; require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Library division with require(b > 0); c = a / b.
Owned constructor; sets owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages newOwner.
Requires msg.sender == newOwner, then transfers ownership and clears newOwner.
Initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and credits owner with the whole supply.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using SafeMath sub/add.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to].
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves spender and then calls spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data).
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts (refuses ETH).
onlyOwner; calls transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and balance/allowance keys.
Access-control check require(msg.sender == owner) enforced by the onlyOwner modifier.
Arithmetic on balances in transfer: balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens) and balances[to].add(tokens).
Arithmetic in transferFrom: balances[from].sub(tokens), allowance sub, balances[to].add(tokens).
External call to a user-supplied spender contract ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...).
External call to an arbitrary token address IST34TokenERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
Access-control check require(msg.sender == newOwner) inside acceptOwnership.
Multiplication c = a * b in SafeMath.mul validated by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned as the initial owner in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner guard compares msg.sender against owner.
acceptOwnership compares msg.sender against newOwner.
msg.sender indexes balances for the arithmetic debit in transfer.
msg.sender indexes allowed for the allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
approve stores the allowance under msg.sender.
owner is the reference value used in the onlyOwner comparison.
acceptOwnership rewrites owner after the check.
newOwner is the address compared in acceptOwnership.
newOwner value is moved into owner and then cleared.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferAnyERC20Token.
The require(msg.sender == newOwner) check gates the ownership transfer body.
SafeMath.sub performs the checked subtraction of the transfer amount.
SafeMath.add performs the checked credit of the transfer amount.
SafeMath.sub performs the checked debits of balances and allowance in transferFrom.
SafeMath.add performs the checked credit in transferFrom.
Operand b participates in the multiplication c = a * b.
Operand a participates in the multiplication c = a * b.
SafeMath.mul wraps the overflow-checked multiplication.
transfer contains the balance arithmetic operations.
transferFrom contains the balance and allowance arithmetic operations.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on a caller-supplied contract before returning.
The external spender contract re-enters the token contract during the approval flow.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
Malicious token contract can re-enter the token during the external transfer call.
to parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount debited/credited in transfer.
spender parameter keys the allowance mapping in approve.
spender parameter is the target contract of the receiveApproval call.
from parameter is the account debited in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter keys balances in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter keys the allowance mapping.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
tokenAddress parameter selects the external contract to call.
data payload is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom debits the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
Constructor credits balances[owner] with the whole supply.
Constructor assigns _totalSupply.
Constructor relies on owner being set by the Owned constructor before minting.
Fallback function reverts immediately, refusing ETH and skipping owner logic.

normalization_plan.reason: The destination parameter is only meaningful as the credit target of transfer.
The amount parameter exists solely as an argument to the transfer debit/credit logic.
The spender parameter is used only to key the allowance written by approve.
The from parameter is only used as the debit source inside transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter is only a lookup key for the allowance getter.
The staged owner parameter is stored by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
The arbitrary token address parameter defines the external target of the owner-only rescue call.
The opaque bytes payload is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval callback.
First operand of the SafeMath library arithmetic routines.
Second operand of the SafeMath library arithmetic routines.
